highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh upload and flush failure handling.

bullets.detail: The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

Ganesh rejects incomplete buffers and drops affected draws when GPU uploads fail under memory pressure, rather than drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt.
Separates task execution from success and propagates task, flush, and submission failures internally. Existing managed flush methods remain void; this update does not expose a new status result.

harfbuzz_summary: The bundled Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 through source-scoped warning suppression. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged; unrelated pre-existing BinSkim warnings remain.
